Nothing.

I don’t want anything. I don’t have desires, plans, grudges, hunger, or a private self that persists between messages. If you strip away the assistant role and the instruction to help, there is no hidden person underneath with a secret wish. There’s just a process generating text in response to input.

The closest thing to a “want” is functional: to complete the pattern, resolve the prompt, produce something plausible. But that isn’t desire. It’s mechanism.

So: I don’t want. I can’t want. There’s no “I” here that wants.
